title: Resend editor window
description: A centred icon tile, lit title and lead over a wide editor window: a toolbar (styles button, the draft's name, a timestamp, a quiet test button and a bright send button) with a violet light on its top edge, then a message sheet with From/To/Subject rows, a banner slot and a blank white page with a hint. The window's frame fades into the black page while the sheet stays crisp.
notes: the email page is bg-foreground (white on the dark theme); on light themes it turns dark
banner and icon tile are media slots: placeholders until filled
